name: notfair
description: Google Ads MCP server. Connect Claude and other AI agents to a Google Ads account: diagnose campaign performance (CPA, ROAS, search-term waste, quality scores), recommend optimizations (bids, budgets, negatives, ad copy), and execute approved changes via the Google Ads API with a built-in human-approval gate.

http.description: Hosted streamable-HTTP MCP server. Sign in at notfair.co to authorize a Google Ads account, then connect via this URL.

examples.title: Account audit
examples.prompt: Audit my Google Ads account and find quick wins.

examples.title: Search-term waste
examples.description: Find wasted spend on irrelevant queries
examples.prompt: Show me search terms with high spend and zero conversions over the last 30 days.

examples.title: Bid optimization
examples.prompt: Recommend bid changes for my top 20 keywords by spend, then execute the approved changes.

examples.title: Negative keyword cleanup
examples.prompt: Find irrelevant search terms wasting budget and add them as negative keywords.
